name: [NEW] 8 Ball Duels
desc:
Welcome to 8 Ball Duels! Compete against other players and defeat them to earn coins and upgrade your equipment! Create trickshots and challenge your friends to complete them

🌌 SEASON 1 - Unlock many new cue sticks and pool tables! 🌌
If you find any problems in the game please tell us! The game is rated very low and we don't know why. Please tell us so that we can fix it

🎱 Pick a country and queue up for a match!
💰 Earn coins and upgrade your equipment!
⭐ Level up and become better!
🏆 Become #1 in the Leagues!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, XBOX, & PlayStation 5!
💙 Like and join the group for exclusive rewards!

⚠️ Cheaters will be permanently banned
